resolution: Napkin math continued (req_2851 follow-on): triangles for the 750MB flora scenarios, plus sanity-check of user's live HUD (24.9M TRI, 3.2ms GPU, ~6 partial chunks, mostly bush+palm). Mesh tri counts from world_loader.zig builders: grass blade 12, flower 12, bush clump 20, frond 48, palm trunk 560 (~1,712 tris per whole palm). Per full chunk: med grass 1.2M, lush 2.8M, bush 4.0M, dense palm 17.3M tris. 750MB-RAM scenarios: bush ~290M, lush ~174M, dense palm ~990M (~1B) tris. HUD TRI is per-frame submitted (3d.zig recordDraw), and the editor preview draws per-family whole batches, so triangle throughput walls (GPU ms/frame) arrive an order of magnitude before the 750MB RAM wall. User's 24.9M@3.2ms ≈ 7.8G tri/s — extrapolates to ~100M tris around a 60fps budget. Answer only, no code changed.
